solutionSql:
WITH avg_by_customer AS (
  SELECT customer_id, AVG(weight_kg) AS avg_kg
  FROM shipments
  GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT s.id, s.customer_id, s.weight_kg
FROM shipments AS s
JOIN avg_by_customer AS a ON a.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.id BETWEEN 1 AND 40
  AND s.weight_kg > a.avg_kg
ORDER BY s.id;

ambiguities.phrase: the average weight_kg of all shipments with the same customer_id, including the shipment itself
ambiguities.readingChosen: The average covers every shipment in the table for that customer, not only ids 1 to 40.
ambiguities.alternativeReading: Average over shipments with ids 1 to 40 only. Measured here: the same 21 rows.

notes: Shipments 20 and 39 have NULL weight and are skipped. The table-wide and ids-1-to-40 averages return the same 21 rows on this sample.
